title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: The doctor informs Kanmani about her pregnancy. Later,  Kanmani urgently asks Thenmozhi to strictly hide this life changing news from Anbu to keep it a complete secret.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Paraman confronts Sidharth for humiliating Ilamathi's parents and demands an apology. Concerned about her financial burden, Kumaresan and Ganthimathi decide to sell their house.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Following Manjamalai's complaint, police investigate Mayandi and Meenatchi over Poongodi's injury. Rejecting their explanation, they summon Poongodi to the station.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Thangaraj tells Ragavan that Bagyaraj secretly goes to see a bride for his brother-in-law, creating trouble. Revathi subtly alerts Bagyaraj about the issue by messaging him.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: With the alliance rejected, Arasi's brothers comfort her and promise to resolve the issue. Kathir and Senthil expose Kumar's false claim, revealing the truth to Karthikeyan.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Cheran's family arrives for the engagement and receives a warm welcome from Chandayatha's family. Later, Kasturi creates chaos over Cheran's attack to stop his engagement.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Sinthamani thanks Sathya for managing the business, and Sathya agrees to a reception. Meanwhile, Vidya alerts Shruthi and Meena about Manoj pressuring Rohini's abortion.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Tamizhselvi feels emotional when Azhagar finally calls her 'Amma' after her plea. Sethupathi joyfully adorns Meenatchi's ears with stickers as earrings.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
episodeTitle: Saranya Stands Up for the Couple
description: Karikalan allows Karthik and Kasthuri to enter the home, denying them a property share. Despite family opposition, Saranya welcomes the couple and performs traditional rituals.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Karthikeyan hides under Kumaran and Sarasu's bed during their romance. Meanwhile, newlyweds Murugan and Indhira share a dream night, winning Lakshmi's heart.

title: Bigg Boss The Common Man
episodeTitle: The Common Man: The Bigg Boss Quiz
description: Contestants battle through a chaotic BB Quiz and hilarious Guess & Act task. As three face a nerve-wracking elimination, a major surprise twist changes everything.
